title: Startup Funding
statementMd:
An e-commerce startup pitches to the investors to get funding. They have been functional for $*n*$ weeks now and also have a website!

For each week they know the number of unique visitors during this week $*v*_{*i*}$ and the revenue $*c*_{*i*}$. To evaluate the potential of the startup at some range of weeks from $*l*$ to $*r*$ inclusive investors use the minimum among the maximum number of visitors multiplied by $100$ and the minimum revenue during this period, that is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc09cb175c0793eedba45d4d2ac6af2fdf5eddc8.png)

The truth is that investors have no idea how to efficiently evaluate the startup, so they are going to pick some $*k*$ random distinct weeks $*l*_{*i*}$ and give them to managers of the startup. For each $*l*_{*i*}$ they should pick some $*r*_{*i*} ≥ *l*_{*i*}$ and report maximum number of visitors and minimum revenue during this period.

Then, investors will calculate the potential of the startup for each of these ranges and take minimum value of $*p*(*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*})$ as the total evaluation grade of the startup. Assuming that managers of the startup always report the optimal values of $*r*_{*i*}$ for some particular $*l*_{*i*}$, i.e., the value such that the resulting grade of the startup is maximized, what is the expected resulting grade of the startup?

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$).

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$) — the number of unique visitors during each week.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*c*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$) —the revenue for each week.

## Output

Print a single real value — the expected grade of the startup. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).

## Note

Consider the first sample.

If the investors ask for $*l*_{*i*} = 1$ onwards, startup will choose $*r*_{*i*} = 1$, such that max number of visitors is $3$ and minimum revenue is $300$. Thus, potential in this case is $*min*(3·100, 300) = 300$.

If the investors ask for $*l*_{*i*} = 2$ onwards, startup will choose $*r*_{*i*} = 3$, such that max number of visitors is $2$ and minimum revenue is $200$. Thus, potential in this case is $*min*(2·100, 200) = 200$.

If the investors ask for $*l*_{*i*} = 3$ onwards, startup will choose $*r*_{*i*} = 3$, such that max number of visitors is $1$ and minimum revenue is $300$. Thus, potential in this case is $*min*(1·100, 300) = 100$.

We have to choose a set of size $2$ equi-probably and take minimum of each. The possible sets here are : ${200, 300}$,${100, 300}$,${100, 200}$, effectively the set of possible values as perceived by investors equi-probably: ${200, 100, 100}$. Thus, the expected value is $(100 + 200 + 100) / 3 = 133.(3)$.
statementZhMd:
一家电子商务初创公司向投资者进行路演以获得融资。他们已经运营了 $*n*$ 周，并且还拥有一个网站！

对于每一周，他们都知道该周的独立访客数量 $*v*_{*i*}$ 和收入 $*c*_{*i*}$。为了评估初创公司在从 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$（包含两端）这一段时间内的潜力，投资者会取访客数量最大值乘以 $100$ 与该时间段内收入最小值两者中的较小值，即：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fc09cb175c0793eedba45d4d2ac6af2fdf5eddc8.png)

事实上，投资者并不知道如何高效地评估这家初创公司，因此他们将随机选取 $*k*$ 个互不相同的周 $*l*_{*i*}$，并将它们交给初创公司的管理人员。对于每个 $*l*_{*i*}$，管理人员应当选取某个 $*r*_{*i*} ≥ *l*_{*i*}$，并报告这段时间内的最大访客数量和最小收入。

随后，投资者将计算每个区间对应的初创公司潜力，并取这些 $*p*(*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*})$ 中的最小值，作为对初创公司的最终评价分数。假设初创公司的管理人员总是会针对给定的 $*l*_{*i*}$ 报告最优的 $*r*_{*i*}$，即选择能够使最终评价分数最大化的值，那么最终评价分数的期望是多少？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$），表示每周的独立访客数量。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*c*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$），表示每周的收入。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数，即初创公司评价分数的期望值。如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说，假设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测程序的答案为 $*b*$。如果 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png)，则评测程序会认为你的答案正确。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。

如果投资者要求从 $*l*_{*i* = 1}$ 开始，初创公司将选择 $*r*_{*i* = 1}$，使得访客数量最大值为 $3$，收入最小值为 $300$。因此，此时的潜力为 $*min*(3·100, 300) = 300$。

如果投资者要求从 $*l*_{*i* = 2}$ 开始，初创公司将选择 $*r*_{*i* = 3}$，使得访客数量最大值为 $2$，收入最小值为 $200$。因此，此时的潜力为 $*min*(2·100, 200) = 200$。

如果投资者要求从 $*l*_{*i* = 3}$ 开始，初创公司将选择 $*r*_{*i* = 3}$，使得访客数量最大值为 $1$，收入最小值为 $300$。因此，此时的潜力为 $*min*(1·100, 300) = 100$。

我们需要等概率地选取一个大小为 $2$ 的集合，并取其中每个元素对应的最小值。这里可能的集合为：${200, 300}$、${100, 300}$、${100, 200}$，因此投资者等概率感知到的可能值集合为：${200, 100, 100}$。所以，期望值为 $(100 + 200 + 100) / 3 = 133.(3)$。
